title: AN SP FIGURE IN THE FEED IS A FIGURE AGAIN
why: Corpus check 27.38 found a medal making two feed lines. Lean2 changed score from $ to SP, but three feed tests still looked for $: the skip of a medal figure label, the merge of a kill popup into the kill line, and the money row for a pick tag.
now: A medal is one line in the feed again, and a kill popup joins its kill line.

edits.replacement:
// v28.xx (cw-feedsp): lean2 turned score from $ into SP, so the skip for a medal's own figure label (" +100 SP") has to read SP too, else a medal makes two feed lines.
  if((/^\s\+(\$|[\d,]+ SP$)/).test(s)) return null;

// v28.xx (cw-feedsp): a kill popup "+50 SP" joins the kill line again, as "+$50" did before lean2.
  if((/^\+(\$[\d,]+|[\d,]+ SP)$/).test(s)) return feedMoney(s);
